entries.823dea84ca55aa0d: This business manufactures and sells frozen and ambient processed foods and seasonings. Mainly in Japan, Table Mark Co., Ltd. is responsible for the frozen food and ambient business, centered on frozen udon, packaged cooked rice and frozen okonomiyaki, and Fuji Shokuhin Kogyo Co., Ltd. is responsible for the seasonings business, including yeast extract seasonings. The company entered the business in 1998; in 2008 it acquired shares of Katokichi Co., Ltd. through a tender offer to make it a group company, and in the same year it transferred the group's processed foods business to Katokichi and integrated the two (Katokichi changed its name to Table Mark Co., Ltd. in 2010). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥159,513 million, a business far smaller than the tobacco business. Revenue rose 1.5% year on year; the company cites the effect of price revisions in its frozen food and ambient business as the reason. Main products are the frozen noodles 'Katokichi Sanuki Udon', packaged rice 'Kokusan Koshihikari' and the yeast extract seasoning 'Vertex'; the business has 16 plants in Japan and 6 overseas. The number of employees is 3,906 as of December 31, 2025 (temporary employees, reported separately, number 190).

entries.a270cbf058f65e35: Centered on JT International S.A., this business manufactures and sells tobacco products in more than 130 countries and regions and is the core of the group. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥3,305,407 million, accounting for most of consolidated revenue of ¥3,467,675 million. It develops the four brands 'Winston', 'Camel', 'Mevius' and 'LD' as global flagship brands, and in RRP (products that may reduce health risks associated with smoking), including heated tobacco products, it operates mainly under 'Ploom'. Revenue from the company's own tobacco products was ¥3,184,384 million; by regional cluster, EMA (Africa, the Middle East, Eastern Europe, Turkey, the Americas and duty-free markets) was ¥1,584,608 million, Asia including Japan was ¥864,223 million, and Western Europe was ¥735,554 million. Revenue from the company's own tobacco products rose 14.6% year on year; the company cites a positive price and product mix (Mix) effect in all clusters and higher sales volume, including the effect of the acquisition of U.S.-based Vector Group Ltd. in October 2024, as reasons. Total sales volume was 577.8 billion sticks (up 2.2% year on year), of which RRP was 14 billion sticks (up 28.0%), and RRP-related revenue was ¥122.5 billion (up 23.9%). Manufacturing facilities comprise 3 tobacco manufacturing plants and 2 other tobacco-related plants in Japan, and 34 tobacco manufacturing plants (including other tobacco-related plants) in 27 countries excluding Japan. The only counterparty disclosed as accounting for 10% or more of consolidated revenue is the Megapolis Group, which operates logistics and wholesale businesses in Russia and elsewhere (¥497,488 million, 14.3% of consolidated revenue). The number of employees was 47,900 as of December 31, 2025 (temporary employees, reported separately, numbered 5,094), and most of the group's employees work in this business.

entries.e7d7f572642ffac0: This category covers real estate leasing and other businesses arising from the use of idle assets, and is not included in the reportable segments. Affiliated companies not belonging to reportable segments consist of 23 consolidated subsidiaries and 3 equity-method affiliates. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was small at ¥2,756 million; because it is not a reportable segment, it is placed last rather than in order of revenue. This category also includes head office expenses, such as corporate public relations costs not attributable to reportable segments and operating costs of the head office corporate departments. The number of employees in administrative departments that cannot be assigned to a specific segment (performing company-wide common tasks of the filing company) is 1,061 as of December 31, 2025 (temporary employees, reported separately, number 123).
